description: This Java source file defines a test utility class 'MongoDbResource' that manages an embedded MongoDB instance for testing purposes. It handles starting and stopping the database, configuring connection settings, and exposing methods to check instance health and retrieve connection details.

classes.name: MongoDbResource
classes.description: External resource for embedding a MongoDB instance during tests, managing its lifecycle, configuration, and connection details.

classes.name: MongoDbResource.FreePortFinder
classes.description: Helper class to find an available free port for MongoDB to listen on.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the embedded MongoDB instance.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the running MongoDB process and cleans up resources.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method to configure and launch MongoDB before tests run.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleanup method to shut down MongoDB after tests complete.

methods.name: isHealthy
methods.description: Checks if the MongoDB process is running successfully.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number on which the MongoDB instance is listening.

methods.name: getBindIp
methods.description: Returns the IP address the MongoDB instance is bound to.
